services.name: Youth Summer Camps
services.desc: This course is great for the young who want to give sailing a try, but aren’t ready for a full week. In this course new sailors learn the basic sailing skills and on-water safety in a fun and engaging environment. Students work towards achieving their CANSail 1 certificate through a mix of on-land and on-the-water experience. This course gets sailors to build on the sailing skills learned in CANSail 1 and develop the in-boat consistency, responsibility and confidence to sail independently. Students work towards achieving their CANSail certificates through classroom and practical experience. The CANSail 2 certificate makes you a sailor, and allows registration for the NOSA Boat-Share program

services.name: Adult Lessons
services.desc: CANSail 1 teaches sailors the fundamental sailing skills, including safety on the water, basic sheeting, steering, and boat handling on all points-of-sail. Students work towards achieving their CANSail certificates through land class and practical experience. CANSail 2 builds on skills learned in CANSail 1 and teaches sailors to adjust their bodies and boats for changes in direction and wind speed while sailing, and to perform boat-handling maneuvers in a controlled manner while in a controlled setting.
